Question: How can I increase my app's downloads on the App Store and Google Play?
Answer: Three words: App Store Optimization (ASO)! ASO is the practice of adjusting your mobile app and app store listing to improve their app store search result rankings and conversion rates. Indeed, the end goal of ASO is to boost downloads. ASO relies on Keyword Optimization and Conversion Rate Optimization. Keyword Optimization is the process of finding the best keywords for your app and adding them to its title, subtitle, keyword field, description, and store listing. Conversion Rate Optimization requires more experimentation. It’s the process of adjusting the visual and textual aspects of your app’s store listing to encourage new downloads.
